name: zettau
label: zeta Tau (B2 IIIpe shell star, SB 133 d)
sources: Wikipedia infobox (read 2026-10-08) and the papers it cites: V 3.01, B2 IIIpe Be/shell star, SB 133 d, T_eff 15500 K, R 5.5 Rsun, M 11.2 Msun, d 140 pc
notes: No interferometric diameter exists: theta_LD = 2R/d = 0.365 mas from the quoted radius and distance; the Pathfinder would be its first measurement.
Claret & Bloemen 2011 linear law of Spica (hot B star) as the limb-darkening fallback; NewEra does not cover T_eff > 12 000 K.
Be star with a several-mas H-alpha decretion disk: resolved out at 300-530 m, so the H-alpha filter measures the photospheric fraction of the H-alpha light against the 550 nm continuum.
T_eff 15 500 K as quoted (low for B2 III; the disk veils the photosphere).

summary.components: B2 IIIpe Be/shell star, SB 133 d
